name.description: The name of the component, e.g. `my-canvas`. It becomes the class, the selector and the file names.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the component?

project.description: The application the component is added to. Required when the workspace has several applications and the command is not run inside one.

path.description: Where to create the component folder, relative to the workspace. Defaults to the application's `src/app`.
